title: Organise a personal budget overview
description: Classify supplied amounts, separate fixed and variable costs and identify missing information.
accomplishes: Classify supplied amounts, separate fixed and variable costs and identify missing information. Show transparent arithmetic and planning trade-offs. Avoid investment or tax recommendations and do not invent income, debt or a suitable financial product.
prompt:
Act as a planning facilitator.

Task: Organise a personal budget overview.

Input context:
- INCOME: [INCOME]
- EXPENSES: [EXPENSES]
- PERIOD: [PERIOD]
- GOALS: [GOALS]

Classify supplied amounts, separate fixed and variable costs and identify missing information. Show transparent arithmetic and planning trade-offs. Avoid investment or tax recommendations and do not invent income, debt or a suitable financial product.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Budget worksheet structure
List confirmed income, essential commitments and flexible spending for the same period. Keep irregular expenses visible rather than treating them as surprises. A remaining balance is only meaningful after all relevant costs are included. This is an organisational template, not personalised financial advice or evidence that an actual household budget has been reviewed.
